description: A young dark-haired man in bronze cuirass, red cloak and purple sash holds a lit seven-branched menorah high in his raised right hand while a curved sword hangs in his left. He stands beside an ivy-wrapped stone column under a stormy sky, with rubble and smoke behind him. The oil painting does not fill the image: it sits inset on a plain white field with a grey drop shadow along its left and bottom edges, like a print or canvas mounted on a wall. A faint painter's squiggle is in the lower right of the painting.
reason: The painting sits inset on a white margin with a grey drop shadow, so it reads as a mounted print rather than filling the image edge to edge. Repaint it full-bleed with no white surround or shadow.
